Candidate per-cell states of the MEDICC2 pieces

Source: R/medicc2_cells.R
cell_piece_candidates.Rd

Per piece, the distinct oriented (cn_a, cn_b) of the clones plus the neutral state (1:1 on diploid pieces, 1:0 on haploid pieces such as male chrX; haploid pieces keep only cn_b = 0 states). The prior is uniform over a piece's candidates (uniform), p_neutral on the neutral state and the rest split evenly (neutral), or (clone_freq) proportional to the summed size (n_assigned, else 1 per clone) of the clones carrying the state plus a pseudo-count of pseudo x the total size (so that a state no clone has, e.g. the neutral state of an all-gained piece, keeps a small prior).

Usage

cell_piece_candidates(
  pieces,
  clones = NULL,
  prior = c("uniform", "clone_freq", "neutral"),
  pseudo = 0.01,
  p_neutral = 0.5
)

Arguments

pieces

long table clone x piece with piece, chrom, start, end, clone, cn_a, cn_b (+ ploidy, default 2)

clones

optional clones table (clone, n_assigned) for the clone_freq prior

prior

uniform, clone_freq or neutral (p_neutral on the neutral state, the rest split evenly over the other candidates: the clone model's state prior, cn_grid(), also gives the neutral state 0.5)

pseudo

pseudo-count (fraction of the total clone size) of the clone_freq prior

p_neutral

neutral prior mass of prior = "neutral"

Value

data.table piece, chrom, start, end, ploidy, cn_a, cn_b, cn, state (cn_a:cn_b), neutral, n_clones (clones with the state), w_clones (their summed size), prior (sums to 1 per piece)
